title: The Holiness of Jerusalem
description: In the conclusion of Zechariah's prophecy, a day is described when everything in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the Lord. On the bells of the horses it shall say, "Holy to the Lord," and the pots in the house of the Lord shall be like the sacrificial bowls before the altar. Every pot in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy, so that all who offer sacrifices may come and take from them and cook in them. On that day there will no longer be any Canaanites in the house of the Lord of hosts.
